rationale: Official Red Hat OpenShift page states OpenShift can build and run AI and manage lifecycle of predictive and generative AI models at scale across hybrid cloud environments. This is AI functionality in the application platform; its conventional app development/deployment core remains meaningful without it, supporting AI-enabled. Product page is current and source record's version/date is unspecified, so binary applicability is weak/forced.
ai_type_rationale: OpenShift remains a broad application platform for building, deploying, running, and managing applications; AI model lifecycle is an additional workload capability, not the sole core offering.
version_scope: Source record identifies managed OpenShift on IBM Cloud but no version. Current Red Hat product page covers OpenShift generally and lists IBM Cloud as a managed partner; historical applicability is unresolved.
issues: Undated record and current product evidence; possible evolution in AI feature availability.
